description: This file defines the React context and hooks for authentication management, including user login, registration, and current user retrieval, utilizing axios for API calls.

classes.name: IAuthContext
classes.description: Interface defining the shape of the authentication context, including user state, methods for login, registration, logout, and message handling.

methods.name: useAuthState
methods.description: Custom React hook that manages authentication state, including user data, loading status, success/error flags, and provides methods for login, registration, logout, and fetching current user.
